digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM Bedrock provider and capability layer
propositions: Add a first-class native AWS Bedrock provider registered as a bedrock builder in the provider factory, constructing BedrockConverseModel/BedrockProvider via the ambient AWS credential chain, instead of fronting Bedrock with an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
Prompt caching must set exactly two keys (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the direct-Anthropic path, rejecting a third bedrock_cache_messages key.

On measured Bedrock, only inference profiles are invokable and caching is model-dependent and fails silently (opus-4-5 bills full input with zero cache counters), so the default must be the verified-caching us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 and rebar must WARN when caching was requested but both cache counters are zero.

temperature is fatal (400 ValidationException) on some Bedrock models like us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 because pydantic-ai's _drop_unsupported_sampling_settings only exists in the Anthropic model, so a supports_temperature capability and an exact-id _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table must withdraw temperature per model without altering f184's shipped, signed _REBAR_OVERRIDES contract.

A provider-agnostic translate_sampling_parameter_rejection helper in failure.py must convert a 400/ValidationException naming a sampling parameter plus a rejection word into an LLMConfigError naming the model id, parameter, and remedies, keyed on error content only with no provider-name branch.

Ship boto3 as a [bedrock] optional extra (also added to dev) so [agents] stays boto3-free while unit tests run in CI, placing the Bedrock builder in a new bedrock_model.py leaf and the live canary under tests/external/ to avoid breaching LOC caps and billable CI calls.
